title: ConsoleAccess
description: Which roles the caller holds in their tenant, so the console can choose which navigation links to show. It is a hint for display only and never an authorisation: every route still decides for itself at the time of the call.

administrator.description: The caller may read agents, templates, and people and HR events in the console. Policies follow in a later slice (D70).

auditor.description: The caller may read the control plane's evidence log in the console (D70).

gatewayAdministrator.description: The caller issues and revokes virtual keys and reads the tenant's usage.
